title: Audit exact pure-Rust image candidate and original browser pixel contract

resolved_items: 2026-11-02: exact 22-package PNG/JPEG/BMP/WebP candidate graph, shipped licenses, native/Wasm builds and no-import link proof reviewed; no application dependency adopted.
56 independent image inputs and full original Chrome pixels captured before the candidate; fresh source recapture matches all 56 states.
